title: Inexpressible
summary: INEXPRESS'IBLE, adjective [in and expressible, from express.] Not to be expressed in words; not to be uttered; unspeakable; unutterable; as inexpressible grief, joy or pleasure.

inlines.v: INEXPRESS'IBLE, adjective [in and expressible, from express.] Not to be expressed in words; not to be uttered; unspeakable; unutterable; as inexpressible grief, joy or pleasure.
